packages/game/gameOptions.ts: GameOptions/GameMode/GameLogger: options objects instead of Config, passed in by the host
packages/game/gamePool.ts: GamePool: hosts several games in one process (host side, no gameplay rules)
packages/game/gameRunner.ts: GameRunner: ticks each game at its options' rates (host side, replaces gameProcess loop)
packages/game/idBitset.ts: IdBitset: per-client visibility set of object ids (netSync bookkeeping, no gameplay rules)
packages/game/localConnection.ts: in-page connection for offline/local games (transport, no gameplay rules)
packages/game/tickStats.ts: tick/net sync timing stats and log throttle for GameLogger metrics (no gameplay state)
